result.title: Manifold Navigation Learning Using Recurrent Networks: Efficient Training Techniques
result.summary: Position tracking is a well-studied problem in Euclidean navigation, yet comparatively little attention has been given to navigation on general manifolds, where motion is governed by the underlying geometry of the space. In this work, we formalize the problem of manifold navigation as a velocity-driven tracking task and propose a coordinate-chart-based learning framework in which learning models operate entirely in a Euclidean representation. Predicted trajectories are mapped to the manifold via an immersion function prior to error computation, allowing geometric consistency to be evaluated without explicitly enforcing manifold constraints during learning. Within this framework, we focus on Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) for sequential position prediction on curved manifolds after comparisons with alternative recurrent architectures. We evaluate our GRU models, trained with pertinent custom loss functions, against both a standard MSE loss function and a naive vector-addition baseline. We evaluate our approach on both analytically (and numerically) defined manifolds, as well as a surface reconstructed from a LiDAR point cloud. Our results show that recurrent models can learn to approximate manifold-constrained dynamics from velocity sequences and consistently outperform Euclidean baselines. Our results demonstrate that certain custom loss functions significantly improve long-horizon prediction accuracy compared to conventional point-wise loss functions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把流形上的导航形式化为速度驱动的追踪任务，提出在坐标卡欧氏表示中学习、再经 immersion 映射回流形计算误差的框架，比较多种循环结构后选用 GRU 做序列位置预测，并对比自定义损失、MSE 与朴素向量相加基线，在解析流形和 LiDAR 重建曲面上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 来自几何导航这一较远领域，其「在简化表示中更新循环状态、映射回原空间再算误差」的思路与面向长时程的自定义损失，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新方式与轨迹级监督设计提供类比线索，可供核查。
